notes.title: Life as Designed is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36329174/231d434f540d1a3c58364971a611536b18da6d3c.png[/img]

Life as Designed, the romance and coming-of-age story featuring Cho Fukuda, is now available for purchase!

[i]Cho Fukuda has spent much of her adult life as a freelance costume designer, to the point that she feels like she's been typecast. Her motivation to work on projects that all feel the same flounders until she ends up botching a commission, leaving her with no leads and the feeling that she's made a mistake with her life. With Cho out of a job for the time being, she and her girlfriend will soon have to explore how their love will adjust to this new challenge.[/i]

Taking place about ten years after the events of Eldritch Academy, this visual novel continues the story of Cho Fukuda and her friends Akomi Miyazaki, Kagami Nakayama, and Yue Ishikami. (Some knowledge of Eldritch Academy is recommended, but not required to understand this story.) This game explores how the direction of Cho's life might change depending on who is her pillar of support, including an unlockable bonus route that depicts a relationship not seen in Eldritch Academy. Each of the three main routes has two endings, with neither of them being more or less valid than the other.

notes.title: Release v8 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40626404/0e41840295f91a0ea0fee61e76257f05ce01c7a4.png[/img]

It's been a long time since the last update, but v8 is finally here! The main focus this time is the addition of more side stories, showing relationships between existing characters while also introducing the new character Sakura. There's also a bonus mode that behaves like a simplified dating sim, which allows the player to set up scenarios about their favorite pairings.

[b]Changes/Additions for v8:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the side stories "Blooming Flower", "Rekindled", and "Roommates"
[*] Added "Sim Akiramine" to the side story menu
[*] All main stories are now named in the story menu (instead of just showing the focus character's name)
[*] "Music Test" feature added to the Config menu
[/list]
[b]Planned Upcoming Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] At least one more side story
[*] Tweaks and fixes
[/list]
That's all for this update. I hope people continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: A New Bonus Feature in v8?
notes.notes:
While I've tried to spend the last few months weaning myself off overworking on my writing to avoid burnout (thus the delays to v8 and my other projects), I've still done a lot of tinkering with Python and Ren'Py. Recently, that tinkering resulted in something that I almost feel could be worth expanding into a bonus feature for Flowering Nightshade.

The working title: "[b]Sim Akiramine[/b]". It's a simple dating sim that features the characters from Flowering Nightshade, allowing the player to pair off characters that may not get much screentime together otherwise. (Or just "continue" the stories of existing couples...)

Here's how it works (as of right now):

After starting the dating sim via the side stories menu, the player picks a character to play as. This list includes every character in the game, even the side stories. (So if you wanted to play as Yae, you can do so.) After that, the player spends each turn performing activities (to raise stats) or going on dates (to improve relationships).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40626404/d8ab354b3c3ec0f77233590cce2ce821b46750c7.png[/img]

The stats that can be raised are:

[list][*][b]Hobbies[/b]; represents how well the character can entertain herself and others[/*][*][b]Devotion[/b]; represents the character's ability to commit in the long term[/*][*][b]Humor[/b]; represents the character's ability to keep positive[/*][/list]
Each character's relationship to the main character is split into two parts:

[list][*][b]Friendship[/b]; represents how well the two characters get along and enjoy their time together, 4 ranks, tied to Hobbies stat[/*][*][b]Attraction[/b]; represents how physically/romantically interested the characters are in each other, 3 ranks, tied to Devotion stat[/*][/list]
During a turn, the player can check their stats/relationships, view potential activities and dates, and change who they want to spend the next date with. Each character also has certain preferences, which can impact how effective certain activities can be when playing as or dating that character. After raising their relationship with a character, the player can choose to start an official relationship with that character, which ties into the next point...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40626404/ec197f0af72a4c3e0cf704038896ffa9979c4dc8.png[/img]

After every 10 turns (representing about a month), the player gets a summary of how their official relationship is going, based on the current relationship ranks. Whether or not the player character is dating anyone, this is also when stats and relationships will slightly degrade. Stats will not reduce past a certain threshold, but relationships can eventually deteriorate to 0%. This means there is always something to do, but also requires rebuilding relationships if they slip down too low.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40626404/c8693192ff466b35e985bb894e050f3812861b05.png[/img]

Another mechanic that is being considered is to have mini-events whenever the player first reaches a new relationship rank with a character, or first starts dating her. The scenes have to be fairly short and generic due to the number of potential pairings, but hopefully it's better than having it solely be a numbers game. (If this works well, maybe more mini-events could be slipped in somewhere...)

Aside from a lack of art assets and mini-event text, the basic structure of the game is fairly complete. The real question is, would anyone find it fun enough to want to play? If it were to be included in v8 (or any future release of Flowering Nightshade), would people enjoy it?

That's all I have to show for now, so thanks for reading. (More side stories are still planned for v8/v9, but there's no news relating to those yet.) If you have opinions on whether the feature should be included in a public release, let me know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Eldritch Academy v3 Beta Announcement
notes.notes:
Last year, I announced that Eldritch Academy was getting a major update for Version 3. After a lot of on-and-off work, that update is nearing completion. In the meantime, I figured it was time to give a better look at the update while the last chunk is implemented. For that reason, I'm planning to make a beta branch for the game here on Steam once I've double-checked the common route for any major bugs or issues.

[h1]What's in the Version 3 Beta?[/h1]

The current plan is to have the full game be available in the beta, though some scenes will not have finalized art implementation and final script checks. In general, this is the breakdown:

[list]
[*] Prologue/Act 1/Act 2/Act 3: [b]Implemented[/b]
[*] Act 4/Epilogue: Art not implemented, script under review
[*] Aftermath stories (standalone): [b]Implemented[/b]
[*] Bonus Features: [b]Implemented[/b]
[/list]

If there are any major issues in the "implemented" scenes and features in the beta, bug reports would be very helpful in removing these issues from the final v3 build.

[h1]How do I access the beta?[/h1]

When the beta is uploaded, you will be able to switch to the beta by:
[list]
[*]Right-clicking on Eldritch Academy in your library and selecting Properties
[*]Navigate to the Betas tab
[*]Select the v3 beta branch and apply your selection
[/list]
After this, the game will replace the files from v2 with the v3 beta.

Once the final version is out, you may need to opt out of the beta build to download it. (Needs comfirmation.) This is the same process, but choosing to not opt into any beta builds.

[h1]When will this beta be available?[/h1]

I'd like to do some final checks on the existing content before uploading the beta, so I'd say the beta will be uploaded within the next week or so. I'll delay the beta if something major comes up, but otherwise I'd like to get it out there so people can pick up on any issues that escaped my notice.

I'll post an announcement on the Eldritch Academy page once the beta is available, so keep an eye out if you'd like to try the beta.

[h1]What's different about Version 3?[/h1]

Many of the changes can be found in the [url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/eldritch-academy/devlog/200489/major-update-in-production]original announcement[/url]. A quick summary:
[list]
[*] Resolution, UI, and art changes
[*] New (custom) BGM tracks
[*] Common route script changes (particularly involving choices)
[*] Redundant scenes removed or combined
[/list]
For those who are more visual, I'll leave you with a few new screenshots of the game. I hope everyone looks forward to the update!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36329174/518dae700b3bc2779e379df29645653a25b6505c.png[/img]

notes.title: v7 Hotfix 2
notes.notes: It was brought to my attention that loading a saved game doesn't track achievement progress within Steam. It seems that the progress was being saved, but the connection to the Steam backend was being lost when the game reloaded. With this hotfix, the game should now set up all of the backend information on bootup, rather than when a story is started. Hopefully this will fix the issue, while also granting any achievements that were missed while the bug was in place.

notes.title: v7 Hotfix
notes.notes: A small update to the game to make sure the Prologue story counts as completed after being read. For some reason, one of the v6 -> v7 changes would skip over the step that marks the Prologue as read, so that check is now made earlier to try to avoid that issue.

notes.title: Flowering Nightshade Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36329174/ba75973107620a8cd1581a963b79d0f42a2945fe.png[/img]

Flowering Nightshade (v7) is now available for download via Steam! Check out its store page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652030/

[i]Almost five years have passed since Himeka sought friendship and romance at Solana Academy. She and her friends have grown now, and have to face their adult responsibilities.

As a direct sequel to Blooming Nightshade, Flowering Nightshade continues the lighthearted romance story that began there. The player may choose to resume one of the six romantic storylines from Blooming Nightshade or begin a story featuring a new character.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 6 returning love interests, with stories focusing on the transition to adulthood and maintaining long-term relationships
[*] A new character and storyline
[*] Each story is longer and more focused than the story routes seen in Blooming Nightshade
[/list][/i]
I hope people enjoy this continuation of the story of Himeka and her friends in Akiramine!
